subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should `/pair` require `operator.admin` before issuing the full-access mobile profile, or should non-admin callers automatically receive the limited profile?
rationale: The PR deliberately broadens the default credential boundary, but the current command authorization appears weaker than the authority conveyed by the resulting token; repository history also includes prior device-pair caller-scope escalation hardening.

options.title: Gate full access on admin
options.body: Require `operator.admin` for the full profile and issue the limited profile to callers that have only pairing and secret-talk authority.

options.title: Require admin for all setup codes
options.body: Reject `/pair` setup-code generation entirely unless the caller already has `operator.admin`, simplifying the boundary but narrowing existing workflows.

options.title: Permit delegated escalation
options.body: Explicitly allow pairing-authorized callers to mint administrator mobile credentials and document that trust delegation.

recommendation.title: Gate full access on admin
recommendation.body: Require `operator.admin` for the full profile and issue the limited profile to callers that have only pairing and secret-talk authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history and current feature work place the device-pair bootstrap boundary with this owner.
